title: What “Altcoin” Means
summary: “Altcoin” is shorthand for any cryptocurrency other than Bitcoin. The term covers everything from large, established networks to tiny, obscure tokens.
blocks: “Altcoin” is shorthand for any cryptocurrency other than Bitcoin. The term covers everything from large, established networks to tiny, obscure tokens.
Because the label is so broad, it says nothing about quality or risk on its own — two altcoins can be wildly different in size, purpose and maturity.
When you see “altcoin season” talk, it usually just means attention and money are rotating away from Bitcoin into other coins for a period.
